plugins.name: diff-ask
plugins.description: Ask questions about your workspace diff, anchored to exact lines: hover + to question a line, drag line numbers for ranges, free-form questions from the ask bar, one message with everything. Two tabs: Turns (the files each turn wrote — the same list ZCode's end-of-turn summary shows, grouped by repo and folder) and Work by repository (defaults to the repo the last turn wrote the most in, with its own commit browser).
